cues: A repairer seats a cross-shaped tip in a cabinet fastener and turns clockwise until the hinge holds firmly.
To open a battery compartment, she presses a narrow blade into the slot and rotates counterclockwise.
An assembler matches the blade width to the screw head before fastening a switch plate to the wall.
He applies steady downward pressure while turning a stubborn screw to keep the tip from slipping.
A magnetic tip holds a tiny screw in place as the worker secures it inside a camera housing.
During disassembly, she reverses the rotation to loosen each fastener without damaging the surrounding plastic.
The carpenter turns a long-handled driver repeatedly to attach the latch to a wooden door.
He changes to a smaller tip before tightening the delicate screws beneath the eyeglass frame.
